items.title: Las Vegas Review-Journal August 26 1977 Elvis Death Newspaper Special Supplement
items.ai_notes: [1977 Elvis Death Newspaper Lot] Elvis memorabilia is a niche market; these newspapers are common and generally only sell to dedicated collectors.

Features headline "Combination of Drugs May Have Killed Elvis" along with coverage of local and national news including "Extremists Say Schleyer Slain" and "Carter May Cancel Trip If Congress Lags on Bill." Includes weather, sports, and classified sections.
